notes.title: 2.7 Valentine update
notes.content:
Hi again! Today update is content update for valentines day. January was a very busy month for me (college semester begun and other projects) This update also include some balance changes that I hopes decrease the randomness of the game and make late game more manageable. 

[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421100/3d2faf2e22a5016c6250109f2d169ccc45006a7f.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] In love : Two houses in 2 tile range of each other have a small chance to be in love.
Love bubble will show on the map.
When 2 houses with in love status is merged, they will produce 1 - 3 children, workforces and bonus points.
[*] Children
Children take 1 extra food and can't do work. 
After 7 days, children will turns to functional adults.
[/list]

[h3]Powers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421100/946096058f6fc68983f1cbfabb8ee72a9c5c7206.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Blessing : Change to boost production of buildings in range.
[*] Love angel : Inflict love effect to every houses in range.
[*] Harmony : Void all debuff for the next 4 days.
[*] Relocation : Move a building.
[*] Swap : Swap position between 2 buildings.
[*] Each power now have a cooldown time.
[/list]

[h3]Actions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421100/bcccbff672e3b83b3d5e7c38b0532b5170b1d06d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Change all card removal action with 1 free discard action.
[*] Inspection : Service buildings stop working for 7 days. Then the next 2 week it will produce 100% more resources.
[*] Holy week : Every temple takes 1 food every day. After 7 days they generate 24 faiths each.
[*] Sin city : Quadruple crime rate, double the fine.
[*] Deathcare : House will disappear instead of turning into graveyard.
[*] Commute : Building also check for all house in the same column, row. Increase food requirement by 2.
[*] Baby boomer : Married couple produce 2 more children for 2 weeks.
[/list]

[h3]Levels & map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Show map thumbnail instead of rendering the entire map.
[*] New map Samut Prakan
[*] Unique building "Wedding venue" Inflict love to a houses in range every 2 days.
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Event timeline collapse, expand on hover.
[/list]

[h3]Balances[/h3]
[list]
[*] Option to skip adding building card if you already have at least 5 buildings.
[*] Museum increased range and gives 4 workforce for every ruin destroyed.
[*] Add different faith buildings to build-in levels.
[/list]

[h3]Steam[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rank and leaderboard for each build-in levels now accessible from menu.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.6.6 new buildings, new bugs
notes.content:
This patch adds new buildings, fixes some crash, typo, improve controller.

[list]
[*] 3 new buildings mine, church, and mosque

[*] fix silk farm crash
[*] fix controller glitch in setting, visual dialog
[*] controller dpad activate while holding instead of pressing
[*] controller right analog stick now can be used to rotate tile
[/list]

This update fix a number of bugs, glitch and separate string as a external file.

[list]
[*] String in game is saved as a separate file in "assets/strings.json"
[*] Visual settings moved in to a dialog.
[*] Screenshot using F12 should now work.
[*] More information when mouse hover on event.
[*] Add section about event in tutorial.
[*] Add guides that show up in some important events.
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: 2.6.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
This build fix crash caused by draw_block function and more scaling options.

[list]
[*] Added UI scaling option
[*] Gameplay and UI scaling is now a slider instead of toggle (please note that non integer scaling will cause uneven pixel)

[*] Fixed crash caused by draw_block function
[*] Fixed camera position when resizing the screen.
[*] Move resource area upward to increase vertical game area.
[*] Fix typo in some controller menu.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.6 Gameplay Update
notes.content:
First, thank you everyone for trying and playing Nakornsampan. This first update modify the gameplay to improve predictability and strategy as recommended by some player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421100/50efc0321aa40405ddd1df8f6d536dea3e6fcf53.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Each building type (population, services) now take food all at the same day.
[*] Farmland, livestock also harvest all in the same day.
[*] Information about when each building type will take action will be visible as a timeline on top.
[*] Some power now have ability to change the action timing.
[/list]

I've also got a request from some player about QOL feature that I agree should be included in the game including:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421100/19e4c76337ec3ee6842eae0b1117bdbf1b6f74cf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Audio volume is now a slider, not a toggle on / off, and resides in a setting.
[*] Mouse wheel now can be use to rotate tile set.
[*] Card display now shift from bottom to the left side automatically if there is no vertical space left.
[/list]
